# Changes

Source: [affaan-m/ECC](https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC), compared with upstream commit `ef648e0`.

These agents come from an earlier ECC release. Local edits add `not_for:` and `capabilities:` frontmatter lines and write `tools:` as a JSON array. Upstream has since added sections such as “Prompt Defense Baseline” and gan-evaluator’s “Evaluation Mode”; those changes are not merged here.
